spans.s:
समृ सम्-ऋ or सम्-ॠ, cl. 1. 9. P. -ऋच्छति,
ऋणाति (Ved. also cl. 3. 5. P. -इयर्ति, -ऋणोति, -ऋण्-
वति, in some forms also A.), &c., to go or come
together, meet together, meet, be united, run toge-
ther; to come into collision or conflict; to bring
together, construct: Caus. -अर्पयति, -ते, -यितुम्,
to throw at, hurl at (with acc.), strike, hit; to fix or
place in or on, put on, put down, deposit; to deliver
completely over, hand over, consign, commit; to
place back, give back, restore.

सम्-ऋत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, met; come
into collision, clashing together.

सम्मृत सम्-मृत, अस्, आ, अम्, quite dead,
deceased.

सम्-ऋति, इस्, f., Ved. coming together, meeting to-
gether, contact, (Sāy. = सङ्गम); conflict, fighting.

समृच् सम्-ऋच् [cf. सम्-अर्च्], cl. 6. P. -ऋ-
चति, &c., to praise, extol, adore, honour, (सम्-
आनृचे, he has been lauded; but according to Sāy. =
सम्यक् पूजितवान्, he has well honoured, or स्था-
पितवान्, he has established, Ṛg-veda 1. 160, 4.)

समृञ्ज् सम्-ऋञ्ज्, cl. 6. P. A. -ऋञ्जति, -ते,
&c., to strive together or unite together for any
object (with loc.); to promote well or together,
(Sāy. = सम्यक् प्रसाधयति, Ṛg-veda 1. 6, 9.)

समृध् 1. सम्-ऋध्, cl. 4. 5. P. -ऋध्यति,
-ऋध्नोति, &c., to succeed well, be very successful,
prosper, flourish, increase or grow greatly: Pass.
-ऋध्यते, to be completely successful, be fulfilled or
accomplished, succeed, prosper; to share in abun-
dantly, be fully furnished with (with inst.): Caus.
-अर्धयति, -यितुम्, to cause to succeed or prosper;
to cause to be fulfilled; to cause to be abundantly
furnished with.

2. सम्-ऋध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. very prosperous, (Sāy.
= सम्-ऋद्ध, Ṛg-veda

सम्-ऋद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, very prosperous, thriv-
ing, flourishing, happy, fortunate; full-grown, in-
creased, grown, accelerated; fully furnished with,
abundantly endowed with, rich in, rich, wealthy;
completed, full, complete, entire.
—समृद्ध-
यशस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, rich in fame, renowned, famous.
—समृद्ध-वेग, अस्, आ, अम्, increasing in speed,
excessively swift.
—समृद्धार्थ (˚ध-अर्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, having increased substance or wealth, increas-
ing in resources.
—समृद्धी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -क-
रोति, &c., to make prosperous or wealthy.

सम्-ऋद्धि, इस्, f. great prosperity or success,
exuberance, profusion; thriving increase, gain, hap-
piness, good fortune, well-being, wealth; power,
supremacy, sway.
—समृद्धि-समय, अस्, m. a
season of great prosperity.

समृद्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, prosperous, happy, blessed;
possessing abundance of (at the end of a comp.).

समृष् सम्-ऋष्, cl. 1. P. -अर्षति, &c. (see
rt. 1. ऋष्), Ved. to come together, unite with.

सम्मृश् सम्-मृश्, cl. 6. P. A. -मृशति, -ते,
&c., to take hold of, seize, touch.

सम्मृज् सम्-मृज् or सम्-मार्ज् (see rts.
1. मृज्, मार्ज्), cl. 2. P. -मार्ष्टि (sometimes
cl. 1. -मार्जति, also cl. 10. P. -मार्जयति, -यितुम्),
&c., to sweep together; to sweep clean, scour; to
rub or wipe off, clean, cleanse, sweep, purify, wash,
strain, filter; to take away, remove; to stroke.

सम्-मृज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being swept or
cleansed.

सम्-मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, well swept or scoured,
cleaned, cleansed; strained, filtered.

सम्मृण् सम्-मृण्, cl. 6. P. -मृणति, &c.,
Ved. to kill, slay, destroy.

सम्मृद् सम्-मृद्, cl. 9. 1. P. -मृद्नाति,
-मर्दति, &c., to press or squeeze together, rub or
grind to pieces, bruise, crush, trample upon, defeat:
Caus. -मर्दयति, &c., to cause to be rubbed toge-
ther, &c., crush, pound, bruise; to rub; to clean.
